heading: Monday, March 16, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Mistral AI Mistral Small 4 and Mistral AI Leanstral.

items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral Small 4
items.summary: Mistral Small 4 is a 119B-parameter mixture-of-experts model (6B active) with a 256k context and image input that merges reasoning, multimodal and agentic-coding capabilities into one model with configurable reasoning effort. It is released under Apache 2.0; Mistral claims it matches or beats GPT-OSS 120B on several benchmarks with shorter outputs.

items.headline: Mistral releases Leanstral, an open code agent for Lean 4 proofs
items.summary: Leanstral is an open-weight (Apache 2.0) model with 6B active parameters for writing and verifying formal proofs in the Lean 4 proof assistant, integrated into Mistral Vibe. Mistral reports it outperforms Claude Sonnet 4.6 on its FLT-based benchmark at a fraction of the cost.
